metadata.description: Visual identity that belongs to the product, not to a template. Capability routing to the best stack, a binding design contract, a design judged on the rendered page rather than on its source, and audited delivery. The doctrine is enforced by dependency-free scripts rather than executed in the head: a palette generator that derives ground, ink and accent from one provenance fact and measures every pair before the tokens ship; a render pass that resolves its own browser and captures 390/768/1440 plus 320px and 200% zoom; and a contract checker that fails a missing grid block, a missing component grammar or one of its keys left with no value, a provenance fact that is a mood, an unscored rubric, or a repeated palette/face/layout triple across the divergence log. Generation is treated as the harder half: facts are looked up rather than recalled from eight named wells, three whole art directions are generated from three different facts and two killed on the brief's terms before any token exists, the trend press is explicitly not an input because a trend list describes the mean, and the variance rule names where a page is deliberately uneven — density, scale, one motion moment — because uniform padding, radius and card height is the most reliable tell of a generated page. Color adds OKLCH harmony for categorical sets and APCA as a readability ceiling above the WCAG floor; type resolves a class table against libre foundries instead of the four family names every model already has; motion gets a choreography block and the CSS scroll-driven toolkit; composition gets a reading path and a density map before the grid.

plugins.name: unique
plugins.description: Generates visuals that are unique to the product they are for, and builds them on the right stack. Five skills: product-brief turns an idea into surfaces and capabilities; stack-route picks the best technology per capability against one shared byte and main-thread budget, with a platform-primitive-first rubric and a fidelity ladder for 3D, particles, data viz, editors, realtime and AI UI — every choice recorded with its rejected alternative and its fallback; frontend-design commits to a design contract that separates 'make it unique' (falsifiable originality gates, provenance tracing every color and typeface to a fact about the subject) from 'as good as Stripe' (borrow the craft bar, never the look) from 'match our system'; a spectacle doctrine decides when 3D, shaders, particles and ambient motion are actually earned — every effect must reveal a mechanism, respond to the person, or repay attention, priced by visit frequency, derived from the subject's own verb and specified with a mapping, a degrade path and a cut line; build-surface implements semantics and states before the happy path, with heavy capabilities behind a lazy boundary; ship-audit verifies Core Web Vitals, WCAG 2.2 AA, the state matrix and the bundle budget before anything is called done. Design is judged on the rendered page, not on its source: both frontend-design and ship-audit serve the surface, screenshot it at 390/768/1440 and score seven weighted axes against the images — composition, type, color, density, usability, signature and content, weighted into one 0-10 total under a jury-shaped profile for expressive surfaces and a usability-led one for product surfaces, reporting 'not rendered' rather than a verified design when no browser is available. Landing pages get their own doctrine — the page as an argument, a hero taxonomy, proof that is real or absent, and the tightest performance budget in the plugin — and a repertoire of named devices on five axes — composition, type, color and material, motion and interaction, surface and material — supplies what to move to once a default is rejected, because a blacklist alone lowers the floor without raising the ceiling. The tokens are then spent on a derived component grammar rather than on the default control shapes: control height and density, corner treatment, whether structure is carried by border, ground or shadow, the focus ring, one interaction signature, and the three to five places a system is allowed to be recognizable. Every budgeted number names the command that produces it and what to report when the tool is absent. Decisions are written to .unique/ so later sessions inherit them instead of re-deciding.
